Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69
questions.solution:
We apply the options to the given equation & solve it by using BODMAS rule:

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 1) 56 and 9, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 56 + 21 ÷ 7 × 9 = 69

⇒ 98 − 56 + 3 × 9 = 69

⇒ 98 − 56 + 27 = 69

⇒ 125 - 56 = 69

⇒ 69 = 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 2) 56 and 21, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 9 + 56 ÷ 7 × 21 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 8 × 21 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 168 = 69

⇒ 266 - 9 = 69

⇒ 257 ≠ 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 3) 98 and 9, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 9 − 98 + 21 ÷ 7 × 56 = 69

⇒ 9 − 98 + 3 × 56 = 69

⇒ 9 − 98 + 168 = 69

⇒ 177 - 98 = 69

⇒ 79 ≠ 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 4) 21 and 7, + and −

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 9 + 7 ÷ 21 × 56 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 0.33 × 56 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 18.66 = 69

⇒ 116.66 - 9 = 69

⇒ 107.66 ≠ 69

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.q: The 11th Fundamental Duty was added to Indian Constitution in which year?
questions.solution:

Key Points

• Fundamental Duties

• To his ward or child between the ages of six and fourteen, provide educational possibilities. The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002 added this duty.

Additional Information

• Indian Constitution

• The Indian Constitution is the country's highest law. The document outlines the framework that delineates the core political code, as well as the fundamental rights, guiding principles, and responsibilities of citizens.

• It also spells out the organisation, methods, powers, and duties of governmental institutions. It is the world's longest-written national constitution.

• It confers constitutional supremacy (as opposed to parliamentary supremacy, given that a constituent assembly rather than Parliament produced it), and its preamble contains a proclamation that it was ratified by the people.

• The constitution cannot be overruled by parliament. B. R. Ambedkar and the Indian Constitution are featured on an Indian postage stamp from 2015.

• On 26 November 1949, the Indian Constituent Assembly approved it, and on 26 January 1950, it went into effect.

• The Dominion of India became the Republic of India when the constitution took the place of the Government of India Act 1935 as the primary law governing the nation.

questions.q: In October 2022, ‘Tele-MANAS’ initiative was launched by the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. What does ‘M’ stand for in MANAS?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Mental health.

Key Points

• Tele MANAS

• The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare started the "Tele-MANAS" project in October 2022. M stands for mental health in MANAS.

• In October 2022, the Tele-MANAS (Telemental Health Assistance and Networking Across States) initiative was launched by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.

• In order to provide free, round-the-clock tele-mental health services to everyone in the country, Tele-MANAS is concentrating on underprivileged or isolated communities.

• The plan includes a network of 23 centres for tele-mental health excellence, with NIMHANS acting as the scheme's nodal body and the International Institute of Information Technology-Bangalore (IIITB) offering technical support.

• The National Health Systems Resource Center (NHRSC) and the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bangalore would provide technical support.

Additional Information

• Mental health

• Our mental health includes all aspects of our emotional, psychological, and social well-being. It has an impact on our attitudes, feelings, and actions. It also affects how we deal with stress, communicate with others, and make wise decisions.

• From childhood and youth to adulthood, every stage of life is important for maintaining mental health.

• Despite the fact that the terms are commonly used interchangeably, poor mental health and mental illness are not the same. A person can have poor mental health even if they do not have a mental condition.

• A person who suffers from a mental illness may also experience periods of excellent physical, mental, and social health.

questions.q: Identify the function of the enzyme trypsin.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Digesting Proteins.

Key Points

• Trypsin

• ​The function of the enzyme trypsin is to digest proteins.

• By breaking up lengthy chains of amino acids into smaller pieces, the enzyme trypsin in the early part of the small intestine initiates the breakdown of protein molecules.

• It is a serine protease from the PA clan superfamily that hydrolyzes proteins in the digestive tracts of numerous animals.

• When the pancreatic enzyme trypsinogen, in the proenzyme form, is activated, trypsin is generated in the small intestine.

• The carboxyl side of the amino acids lysine or arginine is where trypsin primarily breaks peptide chains. It is employed in a variety of biotechnological procedures.

Additional Information

• One significant protease, trypsin, has the unique ability to catalyze the hydrolysis of peptide and ester bonds with lysine and arginine amino acids at the carboxyl-terminus.

• Additionally, an autocatalytic, trypsin produces additional trypsin by converting trypsinogen.

• In addition to its basic function of breaking down dietary protein, trypsin also transforms the other two zymogens into chymotrypsin and carboxypeptidase.
